WITH TargetNode AS (

  -- Prepare the ID as both text and a number

  SELECT 

    REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '') AS id_txt,

    REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')::bigint AS id_num

),

UniqueNodes AS (

  -- Dictionary of node names

  SELECT 

    REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '') AS clean_id, 

    MAX(long_name) AS long_name

  FROM node_details

  GROUP BY 1

),

AllPackets AS (

  -- 1. Grab all TR packets and determine the selected node's exact role in each one

  SELECT

    m.time,

    m.packet_id,

    m.request_id,

    REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') AS init_id,

    REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') AS target_id,

    

    CASE

      WHEN REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') = t.id_txt THEN 'Initiator'

      WHEN REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') = t.id_txt THEN 'Target'

      WHEN t.id_num = ANY(m.route_towards) THEN 'Hop ' || array_position(m.route_towards, t.id_num)

      WHEN REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = t.id_txt THEN 'Gateway'

      ELSE NULL

    END AS role,

    

    array_length(m.route_towards, 1) AS hop_count,



    -- Deduplicate aggressively so we only have the best version of each packet

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

      PARTITION BY m.packet_id 

      ORDER BY array_length(m.route_towards, 1) DESC NULLS LAST, m.time ASC

    ) as rn

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m

  CROSS JOIN TargetNode t

  WHERE m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

    AND $__timeFilter(m.time)

),

BestPackets AS (

  -- Filter down to just the deduplicated #1 rows

  SELECT * FROM AllPackets WHERE rn = 1

),

Requests AS (

  SELECT * FROM BestPackets WHERE request_id IS NULL

),

Replies AS (

  SELECT * FROM BestPackets WHERE request_id IS NOT NULL

),

PairedTRs AS (

  -- 2. Zip the requests and replies together

  SELECT

    -- Use the request time, but fallback to reply time if the request packet was lost

    COALESCE(req.time, rep.time) AS pair_time,

    

    -- The Master ID that Grafana will use when you click a row

    COALESCE(req.packet_id, rep.request_id) AS request_packet_id,

    

    -- Align the display IDs (the Target of the reply is the Initiator of the request)

    COALESCE(req.init_id, rep.target_id) AS display_init, 

    COALESCE(req.target_id, rep.init_id) AS display_target,

    

    req.role AS req_role,

    rep.role AS rep_role,

    

    req.hop_count AS req_hops,

    rep.hop_count AS rep_hops

  FROM Requests req

  FULL OUTER JOIN Replies rep ON req.packet_id = rep.request_id

)



-- 3. Final Polish and Presentation

SELECT 

  p.pair_time AS "Time",

  p.request_packet_id AS "Traceroute ID",

  COALESCE(n_init.long_name, p.display_init) AS "Initiator",

  COALESCE(n_target.long_name, p.display_target) AS "Target",

  

  -- Combine the roles visually into a single column

  CASE 

    WHEN p.req_role IS NOT NULL AND p.rep_role IS NOT NULL THEN '🔄 Both (' || p.req_role || ' / ' || p.rep_role || ')'

    WHEN p.req_role IS NOT NULL THEN '➡️ Outbound (' || p.req_role || ')'

    WHEN p.rep_role IS NOT NULL THEN '⬅️ Reply (' || p.rep_role || ')'

    ELSE 'Unknown'

  END AS "Node Contribution",



  p.req_hops AS "Outbound Hops",

  p.rep_hops AS "Reply Hops"



FROM PairedTRs p

LEFT JOIN UniqueNodes n_init ON p.display_init = n_init.clean_id

LEFT JOIN UniqueNodes n_target ON p.display_target = n_target.clean_id

-- Crucial: Completely hide pairs where the selected node had absolutely no involvement

WHERE p.req_role IS NOT NULL OR p.rep_role IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY p.pair_time DESC;

WITH OriginalRequest AS (

  SELECT REPLACE(source_id::text, '!', '') AS initiator, REPLACE(destination_id::text, '!', '') AS target

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics WHERE packet_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP' LIMIT 1

),

ReplyReceipt AS (

  -- 📍 Grab the verified Answer Key

  SELECT m.route_towards

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m CROSS JOIN OriginalRequest o

  WHERE m.request_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

    AND REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') = o.target

  ORDER BY m.time ASC LIMIT 1

),

AllTRPackets AS (

  SELECT m.route_towards

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m CROSS JOIN OriginalRequest o

  WHERE m.packet_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

    AND REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') = o.target 

),

Gateways AS (

  SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') AS gw_id

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m CROSS JOIN OriginalRequest o

  WHERE m.packet_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

    AND REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') = o.target 

    AND m.reporting_gateway IS NOT NULL

),

TRNodes AS (

  SELECT initiator AS node_id, 'Initiator' AS tr_role FROM OriginalRequest

  UNION

  SELECT target AS node_id, 'Target' AS tr_role FROM OriginalRequest

  UNION

  SELECT CASE WHEN t.route_node::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(t.route_node::text, '!', '') END AS node_id, 'Hop' AS tr_role FROM AllTRPackets CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(route_towards) AS t(route_node)

  UNION

  -- 📍 THE FIX: Inject any stealth nodes revealed by the Target's receipt!

  SELECT CASE WHEN t.route_node::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(t.route_node::text, '!', '') END AS node_id, 'Hop' AS tr_role FROM ReplyReceipt CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(route_towards) AS t(route_node)

),

RankedRoles AS (

  SELECT node_id, tr_role, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY node_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN tr_role = 'Initiator' THEN 1 WHEN tr_role = 'Target' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) as rn

  FROM TRNodes

)



SELECT 

  r.node_id AS id, 

  COALESCE(MAX(n.long_name), CASE WHEN r.node_id = 'unknown_hop' THEN 'Unknown Hop' ELSE r.node_id END) AS title, 

  CASE WHEN MAX(g.gw_id) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(r.tr_role) || ' (MQTT Gateway)' ELSE MAX(r.tr_role) END AS subtitle, 

  COALESCE(MAX(n.short_name), right(r.node_id, 4)) AS mainstat, 

  COALESCE(MAX(n.role), 'Unknown') AS secondarystat, 

  CASE MAX(r.tr_role) WHEN 'Initiator' THEN 'green' WHEN 'Target' THEN 'red' ELSE 'blue' END AS color,

  CASE WHEN MAX(g.gw_id) IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS highlighted,

  CASE WHEN MAX(g.gw_id) IS NOT NULL THEN '✅ Yes' ELSE '❌ No' END AS "detail__Is MQTT Gateway"



FROM RankedRoles r 

LEFT JOIN node_details n ON r.node_id = REPLACE(n.node_id::text, '!', '')

LEFT JOIN Gateways g ON r.node_id = g.gw_id

WHERE r.rn = 1 AND LOWER(r.node_id) NOT IN ('^all', 'all')

GROUP BY r.node_id;

WITH OriginalRequest AS (

  SELECT REPLACE(source_id::text, '!', '') AS initiator, REPLACE(destination_id::text, '!', '') AS target

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics WHERE packet_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP' LIMIT 1

),

ReplyReceipt AS (

  SELECT m.route_towards, m.snr_towards, COALESCE(array_length(m.route_towards, 1), 0) AS hop_count

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m CROSS JOIN OriginalRequest o

  WHERE m.request_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

    AND REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') = o.target

  ORDER BY m.time ASC LIMIT 1

),

AllOutboundPackets AS (

  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS report_id, REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') AS initiator, REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') AS target, m.route_towards, m.snr_towards, COALESCE(array_length(m.route_towards, 1), 0) AS hop_count, m.rx_snr AS header_snr

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m CROSS JOIN OriginalRequest o

  WHERE m.packet_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

    AND REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') = o.target

),

LongestFallback AS (

  SELECT route_towards, snr_towards, hop_count, header_snr FROM AllOutboundPackets ORDER BY hop_count DESC, report_id ASC LIMIT 1

),

BestPath AS (

  SELECT o.initiator, o.target, COALESCE(r.route_towards, f.route_towards) AS route_towards, COALESCE(r.snr_towards, f.snr_towards) AS snr_towards, COALESCE(r.hop_count, f.hop_count, 0) AS hop_count, CASE WHEN r.route_towards IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS reached_target

  FROM OriginalRequest o LEFT JOIN LongestFallback f ON true LEFT JOIN ReplyReceipt r ON true

),

UnnestedHops AS (

  SELECT report_id, initiator, target, hop_count, header_snr, CASE WHEN t.route_node::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(t.route_node::text, '!', '') END AS hop_node, t.snr_val AS snr, t.hop_index
  FROM AllOutboundPackets CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(route_towards, snr_towards) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(route_node, snr_val, hop_index)

),

GhostEdges AS (

  -- 📍 The Telemetry Ghosts

  SELECT u.initiator AS source, u.target AS target, (AVG(NULLIF(COALESCE(u.snr_towards[1], u.header_snr), -128)) / 4.0)::numeric AS mainStat, 'Direct' AS secondaryStat FROM AllOutboundPackets u CROSS JOIN BestPath b WHERE u.hop_count = 0 AND b.hop_count = 0 AND b.reached_target = true GROUP BY 1, 2

  UNION ALL

  SELECT initiator AS source, hop_node AS target, (AVG(NULLIF(snr, -128)) / 4.0)::numeric AS mainStat, 'Hop 1' AS secondaryStat FROM UnnestedHops WHERE hop_index = 1 GROUP BY 1, 2

  UNION ALL

  SELECT h1.hop_node AS source, h2.hop_node AS target, (AVG(NULLIF(h2.snr, -128)) / 4.0)::numeric AS mainStat, 'Hop ' || MAX(h2.hop_index) AS secondaryStat FROM UnnestedHops h1 JOIN UnnestedHops h2 ON h1.report_id = h2.report_id AND h1.hop_index + 1 = h2.hop_index GROUP BY 1, 2

  UNION ALL

  SELECT u.hop_node AS source, u.target AS target, (MAX(COALESCE(b.snr_towards[b.hop_count + 1], u.header_snr)) / 4.0)::numeric AS mainStat, 'Final Hop' AS secondaryStat FROM UnnestedHops u CROSS JOIN BestPath b WHERE u.hop_index = u.hop_count AND u.hop_count = b.hop_count AND b.reached_target = true GROUP BY 1, 2

),

TruthEdges AS (

  -- 📍 THE FIX: Unroll the verified array directly into the Edge Pool!

  SELECT initiator AS source, target AS target, NULL::numeric AS mainStat, 'Direct' AS secondaryStat FROM BestPath WHERE hop_count = 0 AND reached_target = true

  UNION ALL

  SELECT initiator AS source, CASE WHEN route_towards[1]::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(route_towards[1]::text, '!', '') END AS target, (NULLIF(snr_towards[1], -128) / 4.0)::numeric AS mainStat, 'Hop 1' AS secondaryStat FROM BestPath WHERE hop_count > 0

  UNION ALL

  SELECT CASE WHEN route_towards[i]::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(route_towards[i]::text, '!', '') END AS source, CASE WHEN route_towards[i+1]::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(route_towards[i+1]::text, '!', '') END AS target, (NULLIF(snr_towards[i+1], -128) / 4.0)::numeric AS mainStat, 'Hop ' || (i+1) AS secondaryStat FROM BestPath CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, hop_count - 1) AS i WHERE hop_count > 1

  UNION ALL

  SELECT CASE WHEN route_towards[hop_count]::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(route_towards[hop_count]::text, '!', '') END AS source, target AS target, NULL::numeric AS mainStat, 'Final Hop' AS secondaryStat FROM BestPath WHERE hop_count > 0 AND reached_target = true

),

CombinedEdges AS (

  SELECT source, target, mainStat, secondaryStat FROM TruthEdges

  UNION ALL

  SELECT source, target, mainStat, secondaryStat FROM GhostEdges

),

UniqueEdges AS (

  -- Merge them cleanly. MAX(mainStat) dynamically prioritizes numerical SNRs from telemetry over NULLs from the Truth array

  SELECT source, target, MAX(mainStat) AS mainStat, MAX(secondaryStat) AS secondaryStat

  FROM CombinedEdges

  GROUP BY source, target

),

FinalEdges AS (

  -- The verified Answer Key used strictly for painting the line green

  SELECT source, target FROM TruthEdges

)



SELECT 

  u.source || '_' || u.target AS id, u.source, u.target, ROUND(u.mainStat::numeric, 1) AS mainStat, u.secondaryStat,

  CASE WHEN f.source IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT reached_target FROM BestPath) = true THEN '✅ Final Route' ELSE '❌ Dead End' END AS "detail__Path",

  CASE WHEN f.source IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT reached_target FROM BestPath) = true THEN 'green' ELSE 'gray' END AS color,

  COALESCE(GREATEST(1.0, ROUND(((u.mainStat::numeric + 20.0) / 5.0) + 1.0, 1)), 2.0) AS thickness

FROM UniqueEdges u LEFT JOIN FinalEdges f ON u.source = f.source AND u.target = f.target

WHERE LOWER(u.source) NOT IN ('^all', 'all') AND LOWER(u.target) NOT IN ('^all', 'all');

WITH OriginalRequest AS (

  SELECT REPLACE(source_id::text, '!', '') AS initiator, REPLACE(destination_id::text, '!', '') AS target

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics WHERE packet_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP' LIMIT 1

),

AllReplyPackets AS (

  SELECT CASE WHEN REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') IN ('ffffffff', '^all') THEN o.initiator ELSE REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') END AS reply_dest, m.route_back

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m CROSS JOIN OriginalRequest o

  WHERE m.request_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

    AND REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') = o.target 

),

Gateways AS (

  SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') AS gw_id

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m CROSS JOIN OriginalRequest o

  WHERE m.request_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

    AND REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') = o.target 

    AND m.reporting_gateway IS NOT NULL

),

TRNodes AS (

  SELECT target AS node_id, 'Reply Sender' AS tr_role FROM OriginalRequest

  UNION

  SELECT reply_dest AS node_id, 'Reply Target' AS tr_role FROM AllReplyPackets

  UNION

  SELECT CASE WHEN t.route_node::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(t.route_node::text, '!', '') END AS node_id, 'Hop' AS tr_role FROM AllReplyPackets CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(route_back) AS t(route_node)

),

RankedRoles AS (

  SELECT node_id, tr_role, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY node_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN tr_role = 'Reply Sender' THEN 1 WHEN tr_role = 'Reply Target' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) as rn

  FROM TRNodes

)



SELECT 

  r.node_id AS id, 

  COALESCE(MAX(n.long_name), CASE WHEN r.node_id = 'unknown_hop' THEN 'Unknown Hop' ELSE r.node_id END) AS title, 

  CASE WHEN MAX(g.gw_id) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(r.tr_role) || ' (MQTT Gateway)' ELSE MAX(r.tr_role) END AS subTitle, 

  COALESCE(MAX(n.short_name), right(r.node_id, 4)) AS mainStat, 

  COALESCE(MAX(n.role), 'Unknown') AS secondaryStat, 

  

  -- 📍 Simple Colors restored

  CASE MAX(r.tr_role) WHEN 'Reply Sender' THEN 'green' WHEN 'Reply Target' THEN 'red' ELSE 'blue' END AS color,

  

  -- 📍 Native Highlight

  CASE WHEN MAX(g.gw_id) IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS highlighted,

  CASE WHEN MAX(g.gw_id) IS NOT NULL THEN '✅ Yes' ELSE '❌ No' END AS "detail__Is MQTT Gateway"



FROM RankedRoles r 

LEFT JOIN node_details n ON r.node_id = REPLACE(n.node_id::text, '!', '')

LEFT JOIN Gateways g ON r.node_id = g.gw_id

WHERE r.rn = 1 AND LOWER(r.node_id) NOT IN ('^all', 'all')

GROUP BY r.node_id;

WITH OriginalRequest AS (

  SELECT REPLACE(source_id::text, '!', '') AS initiator, REPLACE(destination_id::text, '!', '') AS target

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics WHERE packet_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP' LIMIT 1

),

AllReplyPackets AS (

  SELECT 

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS report_id, 

    REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') AS reply_sender, 

    CASE WHEN REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') IN ('ffffffff', '^all') THEN o.initiator ELSE REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') END AS reply_dest, 

    m.route_back, 

    m.snr_back, 

    COALESCE(array_length(m.route_back, 1), 0) AS hop_count,

    m.rx_snr AS header_snr,

    m.time

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m CROSS JOIN OriginalRequest o

  WHERE m.request_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

    AND REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') = o.target 

),

BestReplyPacket AS (

  SELECT reply_sender, reply_dest, route_back, snr_back, hop_count, header_snr

  FROM AllReplyPackets ORDER BY time ASC LIMIT 1

),

UnnestedHops AS (

  SELECT report_id, reply_sender, reply_dest, hop_count, header_snr, CASE WHEN t.route_node::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(t.route_node::text, '!', '') END AS hop_node, t.snr_val AS snr, t.hop_index
  FROM AllReplyPackets CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(route_back, snr_back) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(route_node, snr_val, hop_index)

),

UniqueEdges AS (

  SELECT reply_sender AS source, reply_dest AS target, (AVG(NULLIF(header_snr, -128)) / 4.0)::numeric AS mainStat, '⬅️ Direct' AS secondaryStat

  FROM AllReplyPackets WHERE hop_count = 0 GROUP BY 1, 2

  

  UNION ALL



  SELECT reply_sender AS source, hop_node AS target, (AVG(NULLIF(snr, -128)) / 4.0)::numeric AS mainStat, '⬅️ Hop 1' AS secondaryStat

  FROM UnnestedHops WHERE hop_index = 1 GROUP BY 1, 2

  

  UNION ALL



  SELECT h1.hop_node AS source, h2.hop_node AS target, (AVG(NULLIF(h2.snr, -128)) / 4.0)::numeric AS mainStat, '⬅️ Hop ' || MAX(h2.hop_index) AS secondaryStat

  FROM UnnestedHops h1 JOIN UnnestedHops h2 ON h1.report_id = h2.report_id AND h1.hop_index + 1 = h2.hop_index GROUP BY 1, 2

  

  UNION ALL



  SELECT hop_node AS source, reply_dest AS target, (AVG(NULLIF(header_snr, -128)) / 4.0)::numeric AS mainStat, '⬅️ Final Hop' AS secondaryStat

  FROM UnnestedHops WHERE hop_index = hop_count AND hop_count > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2

),

FinalEdges AS (

  SELECT reply_sender AS source, reply_dest AS target FROM BestReplyPacket WHERE hop_count = 0

  UNION ALL

  SELECT reply_sender AS source, CASE WHEN route_back[1]::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(route_back[1]::text, '!', '') END AS target FROM BestReplyPacket WHERE hop_count > 0

  UNION ALL

  SELECT CASE WHEN route_back[i]::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(route_back[i]::text, '!', '') END AS source, CASE WHEN route_back[i+1]::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(route_back[i+1]::text, '!', '') END AS target FROM BestReplyPacket CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, hop_count - 1) AS i WHERE hop_count > 1

  UNION ALL

  SELECT CASE WHEN route_back[hop_count]::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(route_back[hop_count]::text, '!', '') END AS source, reply_dest AS target FROM BestReplyPacket WHERE hop_count > 0

)



-- 📍 FIX: Raw, chronological order restored!

SELECT

  u.source || '_' || u.target AS id, 

  u.source AS source,  

  u.target AS target,  

  ROUND(u.mainStat::numeric, 1) AS mainStat, 

  u.secondaryStat,

  CASE WHEN f.source IS NOT NULL THEN '✅ Final Route' ELSE '❌ Dead End' END AS "detail__Path",

  CASE WHEN f.source IS NOT NULL THEN 'green' ELSE 'gray' END AS color,

  COALESCE(GREATEST(1.0, ROUND(((u.mainStat::numeric + 20.0) / 5.0) + 1.0, 1)), 2.0) AS thickness

FROM UniqueEdges u LEFT JOIN FinalEdges f ON u.source = f.source AND u.target = f.target

WHERE u.source NOT IN ('ffffffff', '^all') AND u.target NOT IN ('ffffffff', '^all');

WITH OriginalRequest AS (

  SELECT REPLACE(source_id::text, '!', '') AS initiator, REPLACE(destination_id::text, '!', '') AS target

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics WHERE packet_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP' LIMIT 1

),

ReplyReceipt AS (

  SELECT m.route_towards, m.snr_towards, COALESCE(array_length(m.route_towards, 1), 0) AS hop_count

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m CROSS JOIN OriginalRequest o

  WHERE m.request_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

    -- 📍 Target Lock

    AND REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') = o.target

  ORDER BY m.time ASC LIMIT 1

),

AllOutboundPackets AS (

  SELECT m.route_towards, m.snr_towards, COALESCE(array_length(m.route_towards, 1), 0) AS hop_count, m.rx_snr AS header_snr

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m CROSS JOIN OriginalRequest o

  WHERE m.packet_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

    -- 📍 Target Lock

    AND REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') = o.target

),

LongestFallback AS (

  SELECT route_towards, snr_towards, hop_count, header_snr FROM AllOutboundPackets ORDER BY hop_count DESC LIMIT 1

),

BestPath AS (

  SELECT 

    o.initiator, o.target, 

    COALESCE(r.route_towards, f.route_towards) AS route_towards, 

    COALESCE(r.snr_towards, f.snr_towards) AS snr_towards, 

    COALESCE(r.hop_count, f.hop_count, 0) AS hop_count, 

    -- 📍 Safely extract Final Hop SNR from the Receipt Array OR the Hardware Header

    COALESCE(r.snr_towards[COALESCE(r.hop_count, f.hop_count, 0) + 1], f.header_snr) AS target_snr, 

    CASE WHEN r.route_towards IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS reached_target

  FROM OriginalRequest o LEFT JOIN LongestFallback f ON true LEFT JOIN ReplyReceipt r ON true

),

CombinedHops AS (

  -- Hop 0: Initiator (Starting Point)

  SELECT 0::int AS hop_index, initiator::text AS node_id, NULL::numeric AS snr FROM BestPath

  UNION ALL

  -- Hops 1 through N: The journey

  SELECT idx::int, CASE WHEN route_node::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(route_node::text, '!', '') END, (NULLIF(snr_val, -128) / 4.0)::numeric

  FROM BestPath CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(route_towards, snr_towards) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(route_node, snr_val, idx)

  UNION ALL

  -- Final Hop: Only rendered if it successfully reached the destination!

  SELECT (hop_count + 1)::int, target::text, (NULLIF(target_snr, -128) / 4.0)::numeric FROM BestPath WHERE reached_target = true

)



SELECT

  c.hop_index AS "Hop Index",

  c.node_id AS "Node ID",

  COALESCE(n.long_name, c.node_id) AS "Name",

  ROUND(c.snr, 1) AS "Hop SNR (dB)",

  n.latitude / 10000000.0 AS latitude,

  n.longitude / 10000000.0 AS longitude

FROM CombinedHops c

LEFT JOIN node_details n ON c.node_id = REPLACE(n.node_id::text, '!', '')

WHERE n.latitude IS NOT NULL AND n.longitude IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY c.hop_index ASC;

WITH OriginalRequest AS (

  SELECT REPLACE(source_id::text, '!', '') AS initiator, REPLACE(destination_id::text, '!', '') AS target

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics WHERE packet_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP' LIMIT 1

),

BestReplyPacket AS (

  SELECT 

    REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') AS reply_sender, 

    -- 📍 Broadcast Override

    CASE WHEN REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') IN ('ffffffff', '^all') THEN o.initiator ELSE REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') END AS reply_dest, 

    m.route_back, m.snr_back, COALESCE(array_length(m.route_back, 1), 0) AS hop_count, 

    -- 📍 Hardware Metadata

    m.rx_snr AS header_snr

  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m CROSS JOIN OriginalRequest o

  WHERE m.request_id = NULLIF(${traceroute_id:singlequote}, '')::bigint AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

    -- 📍 Target Lock

    AND REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') = o.target 

  ORDER BY m.time ASC LIMIT 1

),

CombinedHops AS (

  -- Hop 0: Target (Starting Point of the Reply)

  SELECT 0::int AS hop_index, reply_sender::text AS node_id, NULL::numeric AS snr FROM BestReplyPacket

  UNION ALL

  -- Hops 1 through N

  SELECT idx::int, CASE WHEN route_node::text ILIKE '%ffffffff' THEN 'unknown_hop' ELSE REPLACE(route_node::text, '!', '') END, (NULLIF(snr_val, -128) / 4.0)::numeric

  FROM BestReplyPacket CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(route_back, snr_back) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(route_node, snr_val, idx)

  UNION ALL

  -- Final Hop: Back to the Initiator, using the hardware SNR

  SELECT (hop_count + 1)::int, reply_dest::text, (NULLIF(header_snr, -128) / 4.0)::numeric FROM BestReplyPacket

)



SELECT

  c.hop_index AS "Hop Index",

  c.node_id AS "Node ID",

  COALESCE(n.long_name, c.node_id) AS "Name",

  ROUND(c.snr, 1) AS "Hop SNR (dB)",

  n.latitude / 10000000.0 AS latitude,

  n.longitude / 10000000.0 AS longitude

FROM CombinedHops c

LEFT JOIN node_details n ON c.node_id = REPLACE(n.node_id::text, '!', '')

WHERE n.latitude IS NOT NULL AND n.longitude IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY c.hop_index ASC;
